---- MODULE W4Od4m2p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Stations == {"presoak","brushes","dryer"}

VARIABLES vote, crashed, decision, wash

TypeOK ==
    /\ vote \in [Stations -> {"none","yes","no"}]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Stations
    /\ decision \in {"none","commit","abort"}
    /\ wash \in {"idle","running","done"}

Init ==
    /\ vote = [s \in Stations |-> "none"]
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ wash = "idle"

Vote(s) ==
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ vote[s] = "none"
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ \E v \in {"yes","no"} : vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![s] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, decision, wash>>

Crash(s) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, decision, wash>>

DecideCommit ==
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ \A s \in Stations : vote[s] = "yes"
    /\ decision' = "commit"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, wash>>

DecideAbort ==
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ (\E s \in Stations : vote[s] = "no") \/ crashed # {}
    /\ \A s \in Stations : (s \in crashed \/ vote[s] # "none")
    /\ decision' = "abort"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, wash>>

StartWash ==
    /\ decision = "commit"
    /\ wash = "idle"
    /\ wash' = "running"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, decision>>

FinishWash ==
    /\ wash = "running"
    /\ wash' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, decision>>

Done ==
    /\ (decision = "abort" \/ wash = "done")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, decision, wash>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Vote(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Crash(s)
    \/ DecideCommit
    \/ DecideAbort
    \/ StartWash
    \/ FinishWash
    \/ Done

WashSafe == (wash \in {"running","done"}) => (decision = "commit")
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WashSafe
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line runs a two-phase commit before physically starting a wash
cycle. A coordinator asks each station (pre-soak, brushes, dryer) to prepare; every station
that has not silently crashed votes yes or no. If all stations voted yes the coordinator
decides commit; if any station voted no OR any station has crashed silently, the coordinator
decides abort. Only after a commit decision may the conveyor physically START the wash
(an irreversible action that engages the drive chain), and once started it later FINISHES.
Any single station may crash silently at any time, contributing no vote thereafter.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the conveyor is never running or finished a wash unless the coordinator
had actually decided to commit.

---- MODULE W4Od11m9p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Workers == {"i1","i2"}
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES epoch, known, grant, spooled

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ known \in [Workers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ grant \subseteq Workers
    /\ spooled \subseteq (Workers \X (0..MaxEpoch))

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ known = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
    /\ grant = {}
    /\ spooled = {}

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ grant' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<known, spooled>>

Refresh(w) ==
    /\ known[w] # epoch
    /\ known' = [known EXCEPT ![w] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, grant, spooled>>

Grantt(w) ==
    /\ known[w] = epoch
    /\ w \notin grant
    /\ grant' = grant \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, spooled>>

Spool(w) ==
    /\ w \in grant
    /\ known[w] = epoch
    /\ spooled' = spooled \cup {<<w, epoch>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, grant>>

Done ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, grant, spooled>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Refresh(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Grantt(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Spool(w)
    \/ Done

GrantFresh == \A w \in grant : known[w] = epoch
====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT GrantFresh
nl:
A print shop runs two independent spooler instances that share one physical printer pool.
To coordinate, the shop uses epoch-numbered reconfiguration: a configuration manager bumps a
global epoch whenever membership changes, and bumping the epoch immediately revokes every
outstanding print grant. A worker instance must first REFRESH to learn the current epoch, then
it may be GRANTED spooling rights only while its known epoch matches the global epoch, and it may
SPOOL a job only while it holds a grant at the current epoch. A reconfiguration may happen at any
time, leaving any worker that has not refreshed stale.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every worker that currently holds a spooling grant knows the current epoch, so no
stale worker can act.

NEXT Next

access slots (each slot is a time-window grant on a lock). Allocating a slot uses two-phase commit:

---- MODULE W4Od9m2p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Feeders == {"f1","f2"}
Cap == 4
Amounts == 1..3

VARIABLES alloc, req, phase, net

TypeOK ==
    /\ alloc \in [Feeders -> 0..Cap]
    /\ req \in [Feeders -> 0..Cap]
    /\ phase \in [Feeders -> {"idle","prep","committed","aborted"}]
    /\ net \subseteq (Feeders \X Amounts)

Total == alloc["f1"] + alloc["f2"]

Init ==
    /\ alloc = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
    /\ req = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
    /\ phase = [f \in Feeders |-> "idle"]
    /\ net = {}

Propose(f, a) ==
    /\ phase[f] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "prep"]
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![f] = a]
    /\ net' = net \cup {<<f, a>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED alloc

Commit(f, a) ==
    /\ <<f, a>> \in net
    /\ phase[f] = "prep"
    /\ (Total - alloc[f]) + a <= Cap
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![f] = a]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "committed"]
    /\ net' = net \ {<<f, a>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED req

Abort(f, a) ==
    /\ <<f, a>> \in net
    /\ phase[f] = "prep"
    /\ (Total - alloc[f]) + a > Cap
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "aborted"]
    /\ net' = net \ {<<f, a>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, req>>

Release(f) ==
    /\ phase[f] = "committed"
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![f] = 0]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<req, net>>

Reset(f) ==
    /\ phase[f] = "aborted"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "idle"]
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![f] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, net>>

Done ==
    /\ \A f \in Feeders : phase[f] \in {"committed","aborted"}
    /\ net = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, req, phase, net>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, a \in Amounts : Propose(f, a)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, a \in Amounts : Commit(f, a)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, a \in Amounts : Abort(f, a)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Release(f)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Reset(f)
    \/ Done

WithinCap == Total <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCap
nl:
A power-grid load shedder allocates load across two feeders that share a bounded total capacity.
Allocations use two-phase commit over an asynchronous network whose messages can be reordered: the
coordinator PROPOSEs an amount for an idle feeder, emitting a prepare message into the network. The
network holds pending messages as an unordered pool, so any pending proposal may be resolved in any
order. A proposal is COMMITted only if the amount plus the load already committed on the other feeder
stays within total capacity; otherwise it is ABORTed. A committed feeder may later RELEASE its load
and an aborted feeder may RESET to idle.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total committed load across all feeders never exceeds the shared capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od12m3p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Locs == {"bankA","bankB"}
Instances == {"n1","n2"}
Total == 3

VARIABLES stock, transit, leader, up

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in [Locs -> 0..Total]
    /\ transit \in 0..Total
    /\ leader \in Instances \cup {"none"}
    /\ up \subseteq Instances

Onhand == stock["bankA"] + stock["bankB"] + transit

Init ==
    /\ stock = [l \in Locs |-> IF l = "bankA" THEN 2 ELSE 1]
    /\ transit = 0
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ up = Instances

Elect(i) ==
    /\ i \in up
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ leader' = i
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, transit, up>>

Fail(i) ==
    /\ leader = i
    /\ leader' = "none"
    /\ up' = up \ {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, transit>>

Recover(i) ==
    /\ i \notin up
    /\ up' = up \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, transit, leader>>

Ship(l) ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ stock[l] > 0
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![l] = @ - 1]
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up>>

Receive(l) ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![l] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up>>

Done ==
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ up = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, transit, leader, up>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Elect(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Fail(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Recover(i)
    \/ \E l \in Locs : Ship(l)
    \/ \E l \in Locs : Receive(l)
    \/ Done

====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps units of blood across two bank locations, coordinated by two
server instances that share the one inventory pool. The instances run leader election with failover:
an up instance with no current leader is ELECTED leader; the leader may FAIL, dropping leadership and
going down, after which a surviving instance is elected (failover); a downed instance may RECOVER.
Only the current leader may move stock: it SHIPs a unit from a location into transit, and a unit in
transit is later RECEIVED at a location. Units are neither created nor destroyed while moving.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of blood units, counting those at locations plus those in transit,
stays constant.

---- MODULE W4Od16m2p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Slots == {"s1","s2"}
Requesters == {"r1","r2"}
Units == {"dispA","dispB"}

VARIABLES votes, holder, reqBy, state

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes \in [Slots -> SUBSET Units]
    /\ holder \in [Slots -> Requesters \cup {"none"}]
    /\ reqBy \in [Slots -> Requesters \cup {"none"}]
    /\ state \in [Slots -> {"open","voting","committed","aborted"}]

Init ==
    /\ votes = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ holder = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ reqBy = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ state = [s \in Slots |-> "open"]

Open(r, s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "open"
    /\ reqBy' = [reqBy EXCEPT ![s] = r]
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = "voting"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED holder

Vote(u, s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "voting"
    /\ u \notin votes[s]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {u}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, reqBy, state>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "voting"
    /\ votes[s] = Units
    /\ holder[s] = "none"
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![s] = reqBy[s]]
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, reqBy>>

Abort(s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "voting"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = "aborted"]
    /\ reqBy' = [reqBy EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED holder

Reopen(s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "aborted"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = "open"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, holder, reqBy>>

Done ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : state[s] = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, holder, reqBy, state>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Requesters, s \in Slots : Open(r, s)
    \/ \E u \in Units, s \in Slots : Vote(u, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Commit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Abort(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Reopen(s)
    \/ Done

NoDoubleDispense ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        holder[s] # "none" =>
            /\ state[s] = "committed"
            /\ votes[s] = Units
            /\ holder[s] = reqBy[s]
====

NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleDispense
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser has two requester front-ends that share one pool of controlled-drug
dispensing slots, with two dispensing units acting as the participants in a two-phase commit. To claim
a slot a front-end OPENs it, recording itself as requester and moving the slot into voting; each
dispensing unit then VOTEs (acknowledges) the slot. Once both units have voted, the coordinator COMMITs,
assigning the slot's holder to the requester that opened it. A slot in voting may instead ABORT (e.g. a
unit times out), clearing the requester, and an aborted slot may REOPEN for a fresh claim.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a slot has a holder, it was committed with both units' votes and its holder is
exactly the front-end that opened it, so no slot is ever dispensed to two requesters.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m6p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Planes == {"p1","p2"}
LeaseLen == 2
MaxClock == 3

VARIABLES onRunway, leaseRem, clock, adminGrant

TypeOK ==
    /\ onRunway \in Planes \cup {"none"}
    /\ leaseRem \in [Planes -> 0..LeaseLen]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ adminGrant \in Planes \cup {"none"}

Init ==
    /\ onRunway = "none"
    /\ leaseRem = [p \in Planes |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ adminGrant = "none"

Acquire(p) ==
    /\ onRunway = "none"
    /\ leaseRem[p] = 0
    /\ onRunway' = p
    /\ leaseRem' = [leaseRem EXCEPT ![p] = LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, adminGrant>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ leaseRem' = [p \in Planes |-> IF leaseRem[p] > 0 THEN leaseRem[p] - 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ onRunway' = IF /\ onRunway # "none"
                      /\ leaseRem[onRunway] <= 1
                      /\ adminGrant # onRunway
                   THEN "none" ELSE onRunway
    /\ UNCHANGED adminGrant

Release(p) ==
    /\ onRunway = p
    /\ onRunway' = "none"
    /\ leaseRem' = [leaseRem EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
    /\ adminGrant' = IF adminGrant = p THEN "none" ELSE adminGrant
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

AdminOverride(p) ==
    /\ onRunway' = p
    /\ leaseRem' = [leaseRem EXCEPT ![p] = LeaseLen]
    /\ adminGrant' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Done ==
    /\ onRunway = "none"
    /\ clock = MaxClock
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRunway, leaseRem, clock, adminGrant>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Planes : Acquire(p)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E p \in Planes : Release(p)
    \/ \E p \in Planes : AdminOverride(p)
    \/ Done

RunwayAuth ==
    onRunway # "none" =>
        (leaseRem[onRunway] > 0 \/ adminGrant = onRunway)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RunwayAuth
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator grants exclusive use of a single runway via time-limited leases. A plane
ACQUIREs the runway only when it is free, receiving a lease with a fixed remaining time. A global TICK
advances the clock and decrements every outstanding lease. When the holder's lease has run out and it is
not covered by an admin grant, the runway EXPIREs and is released; a holder may also voluntarily RELEASE.
A privileged controller may issue an ADMIN OVERRIDE, seizing the runway for a chosen plane regardless of
the current holder or lease and marking it admin-granted.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a plane occupies the runway, it either holds a still-valid lease or is the
plane currently covered by the admin override.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m2p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Updates == {"u1","u2","u3"}
MaxCap == 3

VARIABLES record, committed, prepared, capacity

TypeOK ==
    /\ record \subseteq Updates
    /\ committed \subseteq Updates
    /\ prepared \subseteq Updates
    /\ capacity \in 1..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ record = {}
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ capacity = 2

Propose(u) ==
    /\ u \notin prepared
    /\ u \notin committed
    /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, capacity>>

Commit(u) ==
    /\ u \in prepared
    /\ Cardinality(record) < capacity
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {u}
    /\ record' = record \cup {u}
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

Abort(u) ==
    /\ u \in prepared
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, capacity>>

ChangeCapacity(c) ==
    /\ c \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ c >= Cardinality(record)
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, prepared>>

Done ==
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ committed \cup prepared = Updates \/ Cardinality(record) = capacity
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, prepared, capacity>>

Next ==
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Propose(u)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Commit(u)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Abort(u)
    \/ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : ChangeCapacity(c)
    \/ Done

NoLostUpdate == committed \subseteq record
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network maintains one shared configuration record (the set of applied lock-policy
updates). Front-ends push updates through two-phase commit: an update is PROPOSEd (entering the prepared
set), then either COMMITted, which both marks it committed and persists it into the shared record, or
ABORTed, dropping it from prepared. The record has a capacity that CHANGES at runtime as lock hardware is
added or retired, but capacity may never be reduced below the number of updates already persisted, so a
runtime capacity change can never evict an applied update. A commit is only allowed while the record has
spare capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every update the coordinator has committed is present in the shared record; no committed
update is ever lost.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m3p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Centers == {"cA","cB","cC"}
Servers == {"s1","s2"}
Total == 3

VARIABLES bank, reserved, leader, alive

TypeOK ==
    /\ bank \in [Centers -> 0..Total]
    /\ reserved \in 0..Total
    /\ leader \in Servers \cup {"none"}
    /\ alive \subseteq Servers

Onhand == bank["cA"] + bank["cB"] + bank["cC"] + reserved

Init ==
    /\ bank = [c \in Centers |-> 1]
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ alive = Servers

Elect(s) ==
    /\ s \in alive
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ leader' = s
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bank, reserved, alive>>

StepDown(s) ==
    /\ leader = s
    /\ leader' = "none"
    /\ alive' = alive \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bank, reserved>>

Recover(s) ==
    /\ s \notin alive
    /\ alive' = alive \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bank, reserved, leader>>

    /\ pendingBy[s] = "none"

and blocks new submissions. The scheduler STARTs the next request into the single operating room and later
FINISHes it. Any one workstation may CRASH silently, after which it can no longer enqueue, though requests it
already submitted remain queued.

registered workstation.

---- MODULE W4Od14m7p3t3 ----

    /\ snap \in [Drones -> [Sectors -> 0..MaxVer]]
    /\ claims \subseteq (Sectors \X Drones)

    /\ owner = [s \in Sectors |-> "free"]
    /\ ver = [s \in Sectors |-> 0]
    /\ snap = [d \in Drones |-> [s \in Sectors |-> 0]]
    /\ claims = {}

Read(d, s) ==
    /\ snap[d][s] # ver[s]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d][s] = ver[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, claims>>

Claim(d, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = "free"
    /\ ver[s] % 2 = 0
    /\ ver[s] < MaxVer
    /\ snap[d][s] = ver[s]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = d]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
    /\ claims' = claims \cup {<<s, d>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Release(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] # "free"
    /\ ver[s] % 2 = 1
    /\ ver[s] < MaxVer
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, claims>>

Done ==
    /\ \A s \in Sectors : owner[s] = "free" /\ ver[s] = MaxVer
    /\ \A d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : snap[d][s] = ver[s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, snap, claims>>

    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : Read(d, s)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : Claim(d, s)
    \/ \E s \in Sectors : Release(s)

NEXT Next
INVARIANT CASConsistent
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm claims sectors through a compare-and-swap register per sector. Each sector
holds an owner ("free" or a drone) plus a version counter; the register is free at even versions and owned at
odd versions. A drone first READs a sector to snapshot its version. It may CLAIM a free sector only when its
snapshot still equals the live version, atomically taking ownership and bumping the version to odd. An owner
later RELEASEs, bumping the version back to even. A drone may be slow: it can act on an old snapshot, but the
compare-and-swap then fails to match and the claim is refused, so a slow drone cannot steal a sector.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a sector is free exactly when its version is even and owned exactly when its version is odd,
and any owned sector's owner has a recorded claim, so the same sector is never doubly allocated.

    /\ expiry[s] > 0

    /\ clock = MaxClock

    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

====

NEXT Next

ACQUIREs a free slot only while the number of active leases is below the current capacity, receiving a lease
with a fixed remaining time. A global TICK advances the clock and decrements every lease; a slot whose lease
reaches zero is atomically freed. A holder may RENEW its lease before it expires, or RELEASE the slot early.

currently leased.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a slot has a lessee exactly when its lease time is positive, so no slot is left doubly
allocated across an expiry.

    \/ \E s \in Slots : StopServe(s)

INIT Init

INVARIANT ServeExclusive

A single token circulates; only the node currently holding the token may begin SERVING a slot. Any node may

and must STOP serving before the token moves on. The token is PASSED to the next node in the ring only when the
holder is not currently serving any slot. A privileged administrator may ADMIN-OVERRIDE, seizing the token to a

---- MODULE W4Od5m2p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Lobbies == {"L1", "L2"}
Slots == 1..2
MaxPlayers == 2
NoReq == "none"

VARIABLES inbox, prep, reserved, seated

vars == <<inbox, prep, reserved, seated>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ inbox \in [Slots -> {NoReq} \cup Lobbies]
    /\ prep \in [Slots -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ reserved \in [Lobbies -> 0..(MaxPlayers + 2)]
    /\ seated \in [Lobbies -> 0..(MaxPlayers + 2)]

Init ==
    /\ inbox = [k \in Slots |-> NoReq]
    /\ prep = [k \in Slots |-> FALSE]
    /\ reserved = [L \in Lobbies |-> 0]
    /\ seated = [L \in Lobbies |-> 0]

\* A join request is filed into a free slot; slots are reorderable, so requests
\* may be prepared and committed in any order.
FileJoin(k, L) ==
    /\ inbox[k] = NoReq
    /\ inbox' = [inbox EXCEPT ![k] = L]
    /\ prep' = [prep EXCEPT ![k] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, seated>>

\* Two-phase prepare: reserve a seat, but only if committed plus reserved seats
\* still leave room under the lobby's player ceiling.
Prepare(k) ==
    /\ inbox[k] /= NoReq
    /\ prep[k] = FALSE
    /\ LET L == inbox[k] IN
        /\ reserved[L] + seated[L] < MaxPlayers
        /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![L] = reserved[L] + 1]
    /\ prep' = [prep EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, seated>>

\* Commit turns a reservation into a seated player and clears the slot.
Commit(k) ==
    /\ inbox[k] /= NoReq
    /\ prep[k] = TRUE
    /\ LET L == inbox[k] IN
        /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![L] = reserved[L] - 1]
        /\ seated' = [seated EXCEPT ![L] = seated[L] + 1]
    /\ inbox' = [inbox EXCEPT ![k] = NoReq]
    /\ prep' = [prep EXCEPT ![k] = FALSE]

\* Abort releases a reservation without seating, clearing the slot.
Abort(k) ==
    /\ inbox[k] /= NoReq
    /\ prep[k] = TRUE
    /\ LET L == inbox[k] IN
        reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![L] = reserved[L] - 1]
    /\ inbox' = [inbox EXCEPT ![k] = NoReq]
    /\ prep' = [prep EXCEPT ![k] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED seated

\* A seated player leaves the lobby, freeing capacity.
Leave(L) ==
    /\ seated[L] > 0
    /\ seated' = [seated EXCEPT ![L] = seated[L] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, prep, reserved>>

Next ==
    \/ \E k \in Slots, L \in Lobbies : FileJoin(k, L)
    \/ \E k \in Slots : Prepare(k)
    \/ \E k \in Slots : Commit(k)
    \/ \E k \in Slots : Abort(k)
    \/ \E L \in Lobbies : Leave(L)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: a lobby's committed plus reserved seats never exceed its
\* player ceiling, so no lobby is ever overbooked.
CapacityRespected == \A L \in Lobbies : reserved[L] + seated[L] <= MaxPlayers

====

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker seats players into lobbies of bounded size, coordinating
each seating with a two-phase commit. A player's join request is filed into one of a few
request slots. The slots are reorderable: pending join requests may be prepared and committed
in any order. The two-phase protocol first prepares a request by reserving a seat, and this
prepare step is the capacity gate -- it succeeds only if the lobby's already committed seats
plus its outstanding reservations still leave room under the lobby's player ceiling. A commit
then turns the reservation into a seated player and frees the slot; an abort instead releases
the reservation and frees the slot. A seated player may later leave the lobby, freeing a seat.

Actions: FileJoin (file a reorderable join request into a free slot), Prepare (reserve a seat
under the capacity gate), Commit (turn a reservation into a seated player), Abort (release a
reservation without seating), Leave (a seated player departs, freeing capacity).

SAFETY PROPERTY: A lobby's committed seats plus its outstanding reservations never exceed its
player ceiling, so no lobby is ever overbooked.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m6p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Robots == {"r1", "r2"}
Bays == {"s1", "s2"}
NoBay == "none"
MaxTime == 3
LeaseLen == 2
MaxProg == 4

VARIABLES hold, expiry, clock, progress

vars == <<hold, expiry, clock, progress>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ hold \in [Robots -> {NoBay} \cup Bays]
    /\ expiry \in [Robots -> 0..(MaxTime + LeaseLen)]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ progress \in 0..MaxProg

Init ==
    /\ hold = [r \in Robots |-> NoBay]
    /\ expiry = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ progress = 0

\* A robot leases a bay only if no other robot currently holds it under a lease
\* that has not yet expired; the lease is stamped with a fresh expiry deadline.
Acquire(r, s) ==
    /\ hold[r] = NoBay
    /\ \A o \in Robots : (hold[o] = s) => (expiry[o] < clock)
    /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![r] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, progress>>

\* A fast robot renews its still-valid lease before it lapses.
Renew(r) ==
    /\ hold[r] /= NoBay
    /\ expiry[r] >= clock
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![r] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hold, clock, progress>>

\* A robot does a pick in its bay while its lease is still valid.
Work(r) ==
    /\ hold[r] /= NoBay
    /\ expiry[r] >= clock
    /\ progress < MaxProg
    /\ progress' = progress + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hold, expiry, clock>>

\* A robot voluntarily gives up its bay.
Release(r) ==
    /\ hold[r] /= NoBay
    /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![r] = NoBay]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, clock, progress>>

\* Time advances. A slow-but-not-failed robot that fails to renew in time simply
\* lets its lease lapse; the robot is not dead and may act again later.
Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hold, expiry, progress>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots, s \in Bays : Acquire(r, s)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Renew(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Work(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Release(r)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: two distinct robots never hold the same bay at the same
\* time with leases that are both still unexpired.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A r1, r2 \in Robots :
        (r1 /= r2 /\ hold[r1] /= NoBay /\ hold[r1] = hold[r2])
            => (expiry[r1] < clock \/ expiry[r2] < clock)

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet leases picking bays under a lease-with-expiry discipline. Each robot
may hold at most one bay, and every lease carries an expiry deadline stamped from a global
clock. A robot may lease a bay only when no other robot currently holds that bay under a
lease that has not yet expired; the new lease gets a fresh deadline. A fast robot renews its
lease before it lapses and does picks in its bay while the lease is still valid. Time
advances tick by tick. A robot can be slow but not failed: if a slow robot does not renew in
time, its lease simply lapses and the bay becomes available to others -- but the robot is not
dead, it may release or lease again later. A robot may also voluntarily release its bay.

Actions: Acquire (lease a bay when no unexpired lease on it exists), Renew (a fast robot
extends its still-valid lease), Work (a pick under a valid lease), Release (voluntarily give
up a bay), Tick (advance the global clock, possibly lapsing a slow robot's lease).

SAFETY PROPERTY: Two distinct robots never hold the same bay at the same time with leases
that are both still unexpired.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m1p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
MaxEpoch == 3
MaxServed == 3

VARIABLES token, epoch, view, crashed, served

vars == <<token, epoch, view, crashed, served>>

RingNext(c) == CASE c = "c1" -> "c2"
                 [] c = "c2" -> "c3"
                 [] c = "c3" -> "c1"

\* The next non-crashed controller going around the ring from t (t itself if the
\* other two are down); t is always live, so the result is never a crashed node.
NextAlive(t) ==
    LET s1 == RingNext(t) s2 == RingNext(RingNext(t)) IN
    IF s1 \notin crashed THEN s1 ELSE IF s2 \notin crashed THEN s2 ELSE t

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Controllers
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ view \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Controllers
    /\ served \in 0..MaxServed

Init ==
    /\ token = "c1"
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ view = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ served = 0

\* Pass the ring token to the next live controller, bumping the token generation
\* and refreshing the new holder's view to the current generation.
PassToken ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ LET nh == NextAlive(token) IN
        /\ token' = nh
        /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
        /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![nh] = epoch + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, served>>

\* Only the live token holder with a current view may allocate a runway.
Grant ==
    /\ token \notin crashed
    /\ view[token] = epoch
    /\ served < MaxServed
    /\ served' = served + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, epoch, view, crashed>>

\* A standby (non-holder) controller crashes silently and drops off duty.
Crash(c) ==
    /\ c /= token
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, epoch, view, served>>

\* A crashed controller is brought back online as a standby.
Repair(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, epoch, view, served>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ Grant
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Repair(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No action by an unauthorized or stale participant: the controller holding the
\* allocation token is always live (non-crashed) and holds a current view of the
\* token generation, so no crashed or stale controller can ever allocate a runway.
HolderLiveAndFresh == token \notin crashed /\ view[token] = epoch

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT HolderLiveAndFresh
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator grants runway slots through a token ring of controllers.
Exactly one controller holds the ring token at a time, and only that holder is authorized to
allocate a runway. The token carries a generation number: each time the token passes around
the ring the generation is bumped, and the new holder refreshes its local view to the current
generation. A controller whose local view lags behind the current generation is stale. A
runway allocation is permitted only for the live token holder whose view is current. Standby
controllers -- those not currently holding the token -- can crash silently and drop off duty;
the ring passes the token only to live controllers and never lets it rest on a crashed one. A
crashed controller may later be repaired and returned to standby.

Actions: PassToken (hand the token to the next live controller, bumping the generation and
refreshing that holder's view), Grant (the live, current-view token holder allocates a
runway), Crash (a standby controller fails silently), Repair (a crashed controller comes back
online).

SAFETY PROPERTY: The controller holding the allocation token is always a live, non-crashed
controller whose view of the token generation is current, so no unauthorized or stale
controller ever allocates a runway.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m8p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Workers == {"w1", "w2"}
Shelves == {"sh1", "sh2"}
Units == {"u1", "u2"}
NoLock == "none"
NoUnit == "none"
NoClaim == "none"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, assigned, claim

vars == <<coarse, fine, assigned, claim>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in {NoLock} \cup Workers
    /\ fine \in [Shelves -> {NoLock} \cup Workers]
    /\ assigned \in [Shelves -> {NoUnit} \cup Units]
    /\ claim \in [Workers -> {NoClaim} \cup (Units \X Shelves)]

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NoLock
    /\ fine = [s \in Shelves |-> NoLock]
    /\ assigned = [s \in Shelves |-> NoUnit]
    /\ claim = [w \in Workers |-> NoClaim]

\* Hierarchical locking: take the coarse fridge lock first.
AcquireCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarse = NoLock
    /\ coarse' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, assigned, claim>>

\* Only the coarse-lock holder may take a per-shelf fine lock.
AcquireFine(w, s) ==
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ fine[s] = NoLock
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, assigned, claim>>

\* Stage a tentative claim of an empty shelf for a not-yet-stored unit; the worker
\* must already hold that shelf's fine lock.
Claim(w, u, s) ==
    /\ fine[s] = w
    /\ claim[w] = NoClaim
    /\ assigned[s] = NoUnit
    /\ \A t \in Shelves : assigned[t] /= u
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![w] = <<u, s>>]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, assigned>>

\* Commit a staged claim: store the unit on its shelf if it is still free and the
\* unit is stored nowhere else, then drop the worker's locks and claim.
Commit(w) ==
    /\ claim[w] /= NoClaim
    /\ LET u == claim[w][1] s == claim[w][2] IN
        /\ fine[s] = w
        /\ assigned[s] = NoUnit
        /\ \A t \in Shelves : assigned[t] /= u
        /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![s] = u]
        /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = NoLock]
    /\ coarse' = IF coarse = w THEN NoLock ELSE coarse
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![w] = NoClaim]

\* Silent crash: a worker fails and its locks and staged claim are all dropped
\* together; committed storage is untouched.
Crash(w) ==
    /\ \/ coarse = w
       \/ \E s \in Shelves : fine[s] = w
       \/ claim[w] /= NoClaim
    /\ coarse' = IF coarse = w THEN NoLock ELSE coarse
    /\ fine' = [s \in Shelves |-> IF fine[s] = w THEN NoLock ELSE fine[s]]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![w] = NoClaim]
    /\ UNCHANGED assigned

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : AcquireCoarse(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, s \in Shelves : AcquireFine(w, s)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, u \in Units, s \in Shelves : Claim(w, u, s)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Commit(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Crash(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation of the same slot: every worker's staged shelf claim is
\* backed by that worker's exclusive fine lock on the claimed shelf, so two
\* workers can never hold claims on the same shelf at once.
ClaimsLocked ==
    \A w \in Workers : claim[w] /= NoClaim => fine[claim[w][2]] = w

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT ClaimsLocked
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker stores blood units onto fridge shelves under a two-level,
hierarchical locking discipline. There is one coarse fridge-wide lock and one fine lock per
shelf, and the discipline is strict: a worker must hold the coarse lock before it may take
any shelf's fine lock. Holding a shelf's fine lock, a worker stages a tentative claim to
store a not-yet-stored unit on that empty shelf. Committing the claim writes the unit onto
the shelf -- but only if the shelf is still free and that unit is stored nowhere else -- and
then drops the worker's locks and claim. A worker can crash silently: on a crash all of its
locks and its staged claim are dropped together in one step, while any already-committed
storage is left untouched.

Actions: AcquireCoarse (take the coarse lock), AcquireFine (coarse holder takes a shelf's
fine lock), Claim (stage a tentative unit-to-shelf claim while holding that shelf's fine
lock), Commit (write the claim if the shelf is free and the unit is unstored, then release
locks), Crash (silent failure dropping all of a worker's locks and its staged claim).

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every worker's staged shelf claim is backed by that worker's exclusive fine
lock on the claimed shelf, so no two workers ever hold claims on the same shelf at once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m0p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Lobbies == {"L1", "L2"}
MaxCfg == 3
MaxRoster == 2
NoStage == MaxCfg + 1

VARIABLES config, staged, won, roster

vars == <<config, staged, won, roster>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ config \in [Lobbies -> 0..MaxCfg]
    /\ staged \in [Lobbies -> 0..(MaxCfg + 1)]
    /\ won \in [Lobbies -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ roster \in [Lobbies -> 0..MaxRoster]

Init ==
    /\ config = [L \in Lobbies |-> 0]
    /\ staged = [L \in Lobbies |-> NoStage]
    /\ won = [L \in Lobbies |-> FALSE]
    /\ roster = [L \in Lobbies |-> 0]

NoChampion == \A M \in Lobbies : ~won[M]

\* A player joins a lobby's matchmaking queue; a config edit follows churn.
Enqueue(L) ==
    /\ roster[L] < MaxRoster
    /\ roster' = [roster EXCEPT ![L] = roster[L] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<config, staged, won>>

Dequeue(L) ==
    /\ roster[L] > 0
    /\ roster' = [roster EXCEPT ![L] = roster[L] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<config, staged, won>>

\* Editing a lobby's config bumps its optimistic version, invalidating any stale
\* staged snapshot taken before the edit.
EditConfig(L) ==
    /\ config[L] < MaxCfg
    /\ config' = [config EXCEPT ![L] = config[L] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<staged, won, roster>>

\* Optimistically snapshot the current config while attempting to claim the trophy.
StageWin(L) ==
    /\ NoChampion
    /\ staged[L] = NoStage
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![L] = config[L]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<config, won, roster>>

\* Compare-and-set: crown the champion only if the config is unchanged since the
\* snapshot and no lobby has won yet. This irreversible award happens at most once.
CommitWin(L) ==
    /\ NoChampion
    /\ staged[L] /= NoStage
    /\ staged[L] = config[L]
    /\ won' = [won EXCEPT ![L] = TRUE]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![L] = NoStage]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<config, roster>>

\* The optimistic check failed (config moved under us); abandon and retry later.
RetryWin(L) ==
    /\ staged[L] /= NoStage
    /\ staged[L] /= config[L]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![L] = NoStage]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<config, won, roster>>

\* The privileged admin may crown a champion directly, bypassing the optimistic
\* check, but still only while no champion exists -- the award stays one-shot.
AdminAward(L) ==
    /\ NoChampion
    /\ won' = [won EXCEPT ![L] = TRUE]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![L] = NoStage]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<config, roster>>

Next ==
    \/ \E L \in Lobbies : Enqueue(L)
    \/ \E L \in Lobbies : Dequeue(L)
    \/ \E L \in Lobbies : EditConfig(L)
    \/ \E L \in Lobbies : StageWin(L)
    \/ \E L \in Lobbies : CommitWin(L)
    \/ \E L \in Lobbies : RetryWin(L)
    \/ \E L \in Lobbies : AdminAward(L)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Irreversible-at-most-once: the champion trophy is awarded at most once across
\* all lobbies; no two lobbies are ever both crowned.
AtMostOneChampion == \A L1, L2 \in Lobbies : (won[L1] /\ won[L2]) => L1 = L2

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT AtMostOneChampion
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker crowns a single season champion across its lobbies, and
the crowning is coordinated with optimistic locking and retry. Players enqueue into and leave
each lobby's matchmaking queue, and editing a lobby's configuration bumps that lobby's
optimistic version. To claim the one-shot championship trophy, a lobby optimistically
snapshots its current configuration version, then attempts a compare-and-set crown that
succeeds only if the configuration is unchanged since the snapshot and no lobby has yet won.
If the configuration moved under it, the attempt is abandoned and retried. Crowning a champion
is irreversible and one-shot: it may happen at most once across all lobbies. A privileged
admin may crown a champion directly, bypassing the optimistic check, but still only while no
champion exists, so the award stays one-shot.

Actions: Enqueue (a player joins a lobby queue), Dequeue (a player leaves), EditConfig (bump a
lobby's optimistic version), StageWin (optimistically snapshot the config to attempt the
crown), CommitWin (compare-and-set crown, succeeding only on an unchanged config with no prior
champion), RetryWin (abandon a stale attempt), AdminAward (privileged direct crown, still
one-shot).

SAFETY PROPERTY: The championship trophy is awarded at most once across all lobbies; no two
lobbies are ever both crowned champion.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m6p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Routers == {"r1", "r2"}
NoOwner == "none"
MaxTime == 3
LeaseLen == 1
AdminGrants == 2

VARIABLES owner, leaseExp, clock, inCS, adminBudget

vars == <<owner, leaseExp, clock, inCS, adminBudget>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in {NoOwner} \cup Routers
    /\ leaseExp \in 0..(MaxTime + LeaseLen)
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ inCS \in [Routers -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ adminBudget \in 0..AdminGrants

Init ==
    /\ owner = NoOwner
    /\ leaseExp = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ inCS = [r \in Routers |-> FALSE]
    /\ adminBudget = AdminGrants

\* Lease the critical merge point when it is unowned, stamping a fresh deadline.
Acquire(r) ==
    /\ owner = NoOwner
    /\ owner' = r
    /\ leaseExp' = clock + LeaseLen
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, inCS, adminBudget>>

\* Only the current lease owner may enter the critical section.
Enter(r) ==
    /\ owner = r
    /\ ~inCS[r]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leaseExp, clock, adminBudget>>

\* Leave the critical section.
Exit(r) ==
    /\ inCS[r]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leaseExp, clock, adminBudget>>

\* Orderly release of the lease once outside the critical section.
Release(r) ==
    /\ owner = r
    /\ ~inCS[r]
    /\ owner' = NoOwner
    /\ leaseExp' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, inCS, adminBudget>>

\* An expired lease held by a router that is not inside the section is reclaimed.
Expire ==
    /\ owner /= NoOwner
    /\ leaseExp < clock
    /\ ~inCS[owner]
    /\ owner' = NoOwner
    /\ leaseExp' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, inCS, adminBudget>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leaseExp, inCS, adminBudget>>

\* The privileged admin preempts the merge point to a chosen router, evicting any
\* current occupant from the critical section before installing the new owner.
AdminPreempt(r) ==
    /\ adminBudget > 0
    /\ owner' = r
    /\ leaseExp' = clock + LeaseLen
    /\ inCS' = [q \in Routers |-> FALSE]
    /\ adminBudget' = adminBudget - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Acquire(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Enter(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Exit(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Release(r)
    \/ Expire
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E r \in Routers : AdminPreempt(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion: a router occupies the critical merge point only while it is
\* the recorded lease owner, so at most one router is ever inside at a time.
CSCoherent == \A r \in Routers : inCS[r] => owner = r

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT CSCoherent
nl:
An airport baggage router coordinates access to a single critical merge point where two
conveyor lines join, using lease-based ownership with expiry. A router leases the merge point
only when it is unowned, and the lease is stamped with an expiry deadline drawn from a global
clock. Only the current lease owner may enter the critical section; it later exits and then
releases the lease in an orderly way once it is back outside. Time advances tick by tick, and
a lease that has expired while its owner is outside the section is reclaimed, freeing the
merge point. A privileged operations admin may preempt the merge point at any time, forcibly
reassigning it to a chosen router -- but the preemption first evicts any current occupant from
the critical section before installing the new owner, so control is never split. Admin
preemptions are limited in number.

Actions: Acquire (lease an unowned merge point), Enter (the lease owner enters the critical
section), Exit (leave the section), Release (orderly lease release when outside), Expire
(reclaim an expired lease whose owner is outside), Tick (advance the clock), AdminPreempt
(privileged forced reassignment that first clears any occupant).

    /\ accepted \subseteq Updates

    /\ record = {}
    /\ queue = << >>
    /\ accepted = {}
    /\ inflight = NoUp

\* Accept a fresh update into the bounded work queue. Backpressure: acceptance is
\* refused while the queue is at its capacity.
Accept(u) ==
    /\ u \notin accepted
    /\ Len(queue) < QueueCap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, u)
    /\ accepted' = accepted \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, inflight>>

\* A worker pulls the head update off the queue to work on it.
Dequeue ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ inflight = NoUp
    /\ inflight' = Head(queue)
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, accepted>>

\* Merge the in-flight update into the shared record.
Merge ==
    /\ inflight /= NoUp
    /\ record' = record \cup {inflight}
    /\ inflight' = NoUp
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, accepted>>

\* Silent crash of the worker: its in-flight update is not lost -- it is returned
\* to the tail of the work queue for another worker to pick up.
Crash ==
    /\ inflight /= NoUp
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, inflight)
    /\ inflight' = NoUp
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, accepted>>

\* A fully merged update is retired from the record, freeing its id for reuse as a
\* fresh update arrives over time.
Retire(u) ==
    /\ u \in record
    /\ u \in accepted
    /\ inflight /= u
    /\ u \notin RangeOf(queue)
    /\ record' = record \ {u}
    /\ accepted' = accepted \ {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, inflight>>

    \/ \E u \in Updates : Accept(u)
    \/ Dequeue
    \/ Merge
    \/ Crash
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Retire(u)

\* No lost updates: every accepted update is accounted for at all times -- it is
\* either already merged into the record, still waiting in the queue, or in flight
\* at a worker; it is never silently dropped.

nl:
A subway signalling block system feeds occupancy updates for a shared track record through a
bounded work queue with backpressure. New updates are accepted into the queue, but acceptance
applies backpressure: an update is refused while the queue is already at its capacity. A
worker pulls the head update off the queue to hold it in flight, then merges it into the
shared track record. A worker can crash silently while holding an in-flight update; when it
does, the update is not lost -- it is returned to the tail of the work queue for another
worker to pick up and merge. A fully merged update is eventually retired from the record,
freeing its identifier so a fresh update can arrive over time. The system guarantees that no
accepted update is ever silently dropped between acceptance and merge.

Actions: Accept (take a fresh update into the bounded queue, refused under backpressure when
full), Dequeue (a worker pulls the head update in flight), Merge (apply the in-flight update
to the shared record), Crash (silent worker failure that returns the in-flight update to the
queue rather than losing it), Retire (drop a fully merged update, freeing its id).

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every accepted update is always accounted for -- merged into the record,
waiting in the queue, or in flight at a worker -- and is never silently lost.
